_about: Prices and rewards for this server. Edit a number, save, and restart the server and the card host. Notes that start with _ are not used as prices. A value marked original matches a published help page. A value marked server choice was not published, so change it if you want a different game. Each shop and course-editor entry is under items: edit name and price there.

news._note: The news panel in the main menu. Restart the server after a change.
news.title: Meadow server
news.text: Rides, the shop, and the club stay on this server.

action_points._note: Original: play-alone and ranked cost 20, or 10 with Pro Rider. The bar holds 200. Paddock and friend matches cost nothing.

gear._note: Original: boots and breeches add action points, helmet and jacket add restore. Each step is 10 and stops at 50.

grooming._note: Original: a clean horse is +1 on every stat, and a fully dirty horse is -1. The coin price of an instant groom was not published. full_groom_coins is the price of cleaning a fully dirty horse. The client and the server both scale it by how dirty the horse is. Pro Rider's stable hand stays free.

practice._note: Server choice. The original practice payout was not published.

ranked._note: Server choice for the payout. The original winner rule is fewest faults, then the faster time. A quit pays nothing.
ranked._settle_note: Server choice. Two riders on this server are settled when both finish. If one has not finished after this many seconds, the other wins by forfeit.

showdown._note: Original entry is level 10 and 150 skill tickets, and it does not cost action points. Original coins: 1st 2000, 2nd 500, 3rd 500, 4th-10th 250, 11th-100th 100. 2nd also gets item_apple_big and 200 horse XP. 3rd gets item_apple and 200 horse XP. The client names item_lucky_leaf, but that icon is not in the asset list, so places 4-10 do not grant it yet. The exclusive jacket and the apple slice have no item id in the client.

course_editor._note: The original game included one free show-jumping slot. The coin price for an extra slot, for submitting a course, and for one placed jump was never published. 0 means every slot is free. If you set slot_coins, the first slot stays free and the later ones cost that many coins. piece_coins is charged for every course-editor piece, because the item list has no per-jump price. Names and coin prices for each placed piece are under items. piece_coins is used only when that piece has no price.
course_editor._max_slot_bytes_note: Server limit. A saved course larger than this many bytes is refused. A placed piece is about 32 bytes.

club._note: Original: 20 members, name 30, short name 10, description 400, welcome 100. A rename price was not published.

daily._note: Server choice. The original login gift ran for 200 days and that day-by-day list was not recovered. premium_coins is the larger gift shown for a Pro Rider. The server pays coins, not premium_coins.

treats._note: These match the item cards this server already sells.

new_player._note: Server choice for a brand new account. An existing save is not rewritten when you change these.

level_up_bonus._note: Original: every level-up gives 100 action points, even when the bar is already full (80 becomes 180, 170 becomes 270). Source: the fan site ridingclubchampionships.weebly.com. Coins and skill tickets are a server choice, 0 by default. Paid for every level gained, and listed in the client's level-up popup.

horse_stats._note: Server choice. The original start was 0 in every stat (ridingclubchampionships.weebly.com). The client caps a stat at stat_cap (10) on the skill screen, and 60 levels at one skill point each fill all six, so 0 matches that design. Use one number for every stat, or one per stat: {"strength": 2, "timing": 2, "speed": 2, "acceleration": 2, "stamina": 2, "obedience": 2}. Starting stats count toward stat_cap. Saved skill points are kept when this changes.

starter._note: Given once, when an account has no clothes and no tack. These are the plain pieces already in the shop. The mane is a hair color, not an item. An account that already owns gear is left alone.

items._note: Shop and course-editor labels. name is the text the game shows. price is the coin cost. description is the shop line under the name. Change any of them and restart the server. Fences also get the height added, so a 1.10 m blue fence named Blue fence 1 shows as Blue fence 1 1.10m.
